LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1: PERSONAL AND POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we avoid unnecessary repetition?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately
2. appreciate the value of proper use of pronouns

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1: PERSONAL AND POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the value of proper use of pronouns
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 7.3.1: Personal and possessive pronouns important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we avoid unnecessary repetition?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use personal and possessive pronouns in sentences appropriately
2. appreciate the value of proper use of pronouns

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
